name: PS1 Retro
description: PS1/N64-era low-poly 3D: chunky pixels, wobbly vertices, dithering, flat warm light and small yellow captions. Hermes renders it with /low-poly.

cautions: Research only: a Hermes render is never published.
Hermes renders with the claude-animation-skills skill installed there; record what it used.
True, slightly sad or strange stories suit it: animals, history, odd facts. Check the facts of the story.
Render at 360x640 shown 3x with nearest-neighbour scaling; few-box models, code-drawn textures.

curation.notes: Evidence for trial of a hermes pack (there is no Hermes in CI, so no CI render exists or is claimed). The skill is in the source repository at the pinned commit and the owner reports it works in Hermes. Every portal run of this pack is a research trial, never published.

hermes.input: The run's skill brief gives one shot per clip, in order, each with its seconds and the skill's JSON spec (brief.shots[i].spec), written by Hermes from the approved script and the research notes following the skill's spec and taste rules (lines (two lowercase captions without full stops), sign, prev, next (pixel-font station names), snow); never invent data the script and notes do not give. Render each spec with the skill, fit each clip to the shot's seconds (hold the last frame when the shot is longer, play it faster when shorter), cut them together, add the run's narration as the audio and burn the run's captions in the caption band. No pictures are made for this workflow.
hermes.output: One 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 at 30 fps with the narration, published under /clip/ on the media host. The studio then runs qc-video and the owner scores it on Review.
